current.descent_text: From the top, move to the rappel anchor near a tree at the north end of the formation. With a single 60m rope, two rappels down bolted anchors return climbers to the base; with two ropes, one long rappel suffices. Tie stopper knots in the rope ends — the rappels can otherwise run the ends off the rock.
